summary: ArcelorMittal filed a Form 6-K attaching its third-quarter 2026 earnings release, a routine periodic results announcement rather than a special situation. Reported figures include EBITDA of $2.0 billion (+34% year-on-year), EBITDA per tonne of $155, a reported net loss of $0.4 billion reflecting impairment and exceptional items tied to idling Kryvyi Rih (Ukraine), and adjusted net income of $0.9 billion (adjusted EPS $1.15). Net debt rose to $10.3 billion with $8.7 billion liquidity; $1.1 billion was returned to shareholders in 9M 2026. No transaction, price, or board recommendation is stated; watch European trade measures and working-capital unwind.
